Eli Yaakobov , if both live abroad, the process is to apply through the embassy first to get clearance to enter the country together. After that they would have to start the visa process from within Israel. Or the Israeli partner moves alone first and applies from within Israel , so the foreign partner can save some money and waiting time in Israel.
